sources.method: ZOBOV watershed void finder after published robustness quality cuts

sources.method: Three-dimensional Bisous marked point-process filament finder

sources.name: Planck PSZ2 redshift-positioned galaxy clusters
sources.method: Multi-pipeline Sunyaev-Zeldovich detection with an external redshift counterpart

sources.name: Sloan Great Wall
sources.method: Representative midpoint of the published SDSS right-ascension span; the display distance and end-to-end comoving length follow the paper and do not imply a spherical wall.
sources.confidenceMeaning: A value of 1 marks a published named structure; it is not a statistical existence probability.
sources.extentMeaning: Half of the published end-to-end comoving length, used only to size the map symbol.

sources.name: South Pole Wall
sources.method: Peculiar-velocity and redshift reconstruction; the representative direction is the celestial south-pole density peak and cz/H0 supplies the display distance.
sources.confidenceMeaning: A value of 1 marks the published reconstructed wall; it is not a statistical existence probability.
sources.extentMeaning: Half of the approximately 420 Mpc published span, used only to size the map symbol.

sources.name: Probabilistic basins of attraction
sources.method: Hamiltonian-Monte-Carlo peculiar-velocity reconstruction. This subset contains every Table 2 p-BoA above 50%; centres, cz, volumes and intrinsic probabilities are transcribed from the paper. Display distance is cz/H0.
sources.confidenceMeaning: Intrinsic probability that the basin exists across constrained Cosmicflows-4 realisations, as published in Table 2.
sources.extentMeaning: Equivalent spherical radius derived from the published volume; the real probabilistic boundary is explicitly not spherical.

recordNames.sloan-great-wall-basin: Bassin de la Grande Muraille de Sloan
recordNames.south-pole-wall-basin: Bassin du Mur du Pôle Sud

sources.name: Shapley attractor
sources.method: Cosmicflows-3 peculiar-velocity potential reconstruction; Galactic direction and recession velocity are converted to J2000 and cz/H0 display coordinates.
sources.confidenceMeaning: A value of 1 marks the published reconstructed potential extremum; it is not a statistical existence probability.
sources.extentMeaning: No physical boundary is asserted; the fixed-size map symbol marks only the reconstructed direction and distance proxy.

sources.name: Dipole Repeller
sources.method: Cosmicflows-3 peculiar-velocity potential reconstruction; Galactic direction and recession velocity are converted to J2000 and cz/H0 display coordinates.
sources.confidenceMeaning: A value of 1 marks the published reconstructed potential extremum; it is not a statistical existence probability.
sources.extentMeaning: No physical boundary is asserted; the fixed-size map symbol marks only the reconstructed direction and distance proxy.

sources.name: Cold Spot Repeller candidate
sources.method: Tentative Cosmicflows-3 underdensity direction. The paper treats its distance as a rough lower limit; the map therefore exposes it as extrapolated rather than observed.
sources.confidenceMeaning: A value of 1 marks the published candidate record; it is not a statistical existence probability.
sources.extentMeaning: No physical boundary is asserted; the fixed-size map symbol marks only the tentative direction and lower-limit distance proxy.
